## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (offline, synthetic media only)
- [ ] `pytest`, `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and `mypy src` pass
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_docs.py` run if checks or profiles changed
- [ ] Profile changes keep a `basis` on every rule, and a dated note for observations
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased"
- [ ] No real account IDs, tokens, personal data or local paths in code, tests or docs
